name: Rochester Hills
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Rochester Hills for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events. The new events run from November 27 (All Aboard model railroad exhibit) through December 30, with Santa and Mrs. Claus (December 5) and Old Fashioned Christmas (December 19) at the Rochester Hills Museum, plus the Village of Rochester Hills Santa and reindeer visits and an ornament workshop. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Rochester Hills

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Rochester Hills
  • Meet Santa: Santa and Mrs. Claus at the museum (December 5), Visit Santa at the Village of Rochester Hills
  • Trains: All Aboard model railroad exhibit, 13 dates from November 27 to December 30
  • Crafts: Cocoa and Crafts ornament workshops
  • Season: November 27 to December 30 for the new events

Planning a bigger day out? Rochester Hills families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Detroit, which covers the Detroit Historical Museum, the Greenfield Village railroad and Detroit's other holiday outings.
